simple.meaning: שְׁבוּ (shᵉbûw) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 28:19. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁבוּ (H7618) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate
definitions.full: H7618. shebo שְׁבוֺ noun [feminine] a precious stone (relation to above √ dubious; = Assyrian šubû ᵑ9 ᵐ5 agate ); — Exod 28:19 = 39:12 (+ אַחְלָ֑מָה לֶשֶׁם, ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably identical with that of 7617 through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare 7632 ) meaning to flame ;
